devices.title: Wiwynn SV7100G4 multi-node server platform
facts: OCP Yosemite V3 / Open Rack V2
SV7100G4-C; separate blade identity, not platform alias
Page 1: 4OU cubby; three sleds, up to four blades per sled.
Page 2 chassis specification: centralized 12.5 V DC busbar.
Page 2 chassis specification: four 8030 fan modules per sled, tolerating one fan failure.
Page 1 says four 1U blades; page 2 says four server blades in a 1OU sled. Units retained without reconciliation.

facts: Blade table: 1OU, one-third width of OCP vCubby chassis.
One third-generation Intel Xeon Scalable socket per blade
100GbE multi-host OCP 3.0 NIC shared by four nodes
Blade-table power-consumption row: 130-165 W (Max). Chassis supply listed separately as centralized 12.5 V DC busbar.
Printed table dimensions/weight are not normalized into blade shipping dimensions; mechanical scope needs confirmation.

devices.title: Hyve Jade custom AI network switch
facts: Two 3200 W hot-swappable PSUs, 1+1 redundancy; C20 connector. Printed input range 200-240 V; output table separately lists 2436 W at 180-229 Vac and 3168 W at 230-264 Vac. Ranges preserved, not reconciled.
Air cooling, front-to-rear; four Sunon fans, 3+1 redundancy, hot-swappable.
ONIE installer; vendor states SONiC compatibility.
May 2026 footer names Hyve Solutions Corporation as wholly owned subsidiary of TD SYNNEX Corporation.
Jade is the printed product name; no numeric ordering code or FCC ID provided.
